<xform:editShow><script>function list_check(tableId, controlId) {
   var checkDept=[];
   var tab_id = 'TABLE_DL_' + tableId;
   var tbInfo = DocList_TableInfo[tab_id];
   if (typeof (tbInfo) != "undefined") {
       for (var i = 0; i < tbInfo.lastIndex; i++) {
           var child_id = tableId + "." + i + "." + controlId;
          var temp= $("[name='extendDataFormInfo.value("+child_id+")']").val();
          console.log('check temp',temp);
          if(temp!=undefined){
            if(checkDept.length==0){
                checkDept.push(temp);
            }else{
                if(checkDept[checkDept.length-1]!=temp){
                    checkDept.push(temp);
                    return false;
            }
            }
            
          }
       }
   }

   return true;
}
Com_Parameter.event.submit.push(function(){
    var curr=list_check('fd_lines','code')
    if(!curr){
        alert("Values must agree");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
});</script></xform:editShow>
